correctness.rationale: Exact complete cubical chain model with cells (190,540,375); cellular squared boundaries vanish; rank(d2) is >=339 over F101 and F2. Thirty-six pentagon-pair product tori are cycles and have a unimodular 36-row minor of determinant -1. Therefore rank ker(d2)=36 and its integral kernel equals the primitive span of these cycles. Each of the 823 torus columns is checked as a whole-chain integral combination of that basis. Exact Smith normal forms of twelve coordinate matrices give all free ranks and elementary 2-primary factors. The graph is verified isomorphic to GP(10,2), and the standard deleted-product equivalence supplies the topological model.

value.rationale: This is the complete canonical length-pair torus-lattice spectrum of the dodecahedral two-point space. It distinguishes full-rank but nonprimitive geometric generating families; in particular 75 octagon-pair tori have index 4096 and quotient (Z/2)^12, while pentagon-eleven-cycle tori generate integrally. The finite invariant is mathematically motivated by shortest geometric loop-product representatives and is not determined by known rational homology or character.
